crop.center_source: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (human-supplied, not AI-verified)
crop.name: Gale Crater region

hillshade.png.note: exaggeration is for contrast only; it is not applied to any data file

slope.bin.note: slope in degrees = value * degrees_per_step; computed at 1.85 km per pixel, so steep local terrain is under-stated

grid.col_spacing_method: pixel_size_m * cos(latitude of the row), latitude from the row's pixel center
grid.nodata_note: PDS label defines no missing-value constant; 0 m is valid elevation
grid.pixel_convention: grid edge at the upper-left corner; value assumed at pixel center

source.dataset: MGS MOLA MEGDR topography, megt90n000fb (PDS Geosciences Node)
